jdp_donnager_bounty.job_description:
Operation Silent Wall has recently been embarked upon by ==Tri-Tachyon==, a new initiative that seeks to increase quarterly revenue by restricting access to the pirate assets on ==$location== in the ==$system== system. These intensive anti-piracy efforts have lead to the deployment of the ==$shipName== outside the home fleet at Hybrasil. Flagship of the infamous ==$name==, the ==$shipName== and her battlegroup is predicted to be markedly effective against pirate forces and will likely enforce a soft blockade.

Head of the Tri-Tachyon Customer and Client Service Smart Database Loyalty Division, ==$name== herself is a highly valued bounty and is feared among anti-corporate groups for her role in the takeover of Port Tse Franchise Station.

Many bounty contracts have been posted requesting the removal of her fleet from orbit around ==$location==, mainly from smugglers and pirate captains but also the occasional legitimate private enterprise, all of whom are uncomfortable about the prospect of a corporate takeover of the ==$location Freeport==. Collated, these contracts add up to around ==$reward==, and the destruction of the blockading ships would likely increase social standing amongst unsavoury types. The recovery and misuse of Tri-Tachyon assets would likely only be frowned upon by the corporation itself, and would be defensible as ‘legitimate salvage’ to most factions.
jdp_donnager_bounty.job_comm_reply: Attention, your presence here has been logged by the Tri-Tachyon Customer and Client Service Smart Database Loyalty Division. You will be taken as a threat to company assets if you do not leave the vicinity of the ==$location Blockade== immediately.
jdp_donnager_bounty.job_intel_success: With death of Captain Theresa Zhetai, Operation Silent Wall has been deemed unprofitable by the Tri-Tachyon Board who are reluctantly cutting their losses on the endeavour, it appears no attempt will be made to reclaim the TTS Iceni.

jdp_phoenix_bounty.job_description:
A coalition of freetraders and other civilian organisations have collectively posted a bounty on the Pirate Lord ==$name==, who leads from his flagship the ==$shipName==, a modified variant of the immensely rare ==Falcon (VI)==. The contract notes that the ==$shipName== has been confirmed to be previously destroyed by multiple mercenary groups, leading many to suggest ==$name== has access to a ==Domain-Era Datachip== containing the specifications for the production of the base hull. Part of the stipulation of the contract, and the justification for the low reward, is that ==the seizing of this data would be worth a high price== to many legitimate and illegitimate buyers. 

The Sixth Battlegroup successfully rotated out of the Persean sector just before the collapse of the Gate Network, their convenient absence is still the core of many a conspiracy theory decades later. While in theory they left many military assets to the Fourteenth Battlegroup, by the time of their arrival after the Cold Passage almost all of them had been pushed into service by the polities that rose up in the interim. It has long been speculated that at the request of the Domain Admiralty, the Sixth Battlegroup left hidden somewhere in the sector a ==Domain-Era Datachip== containing the specifications for their unique hull variants in order to bolster the disgraced Fourteenth Battlegroup. It appears that ==$name== was the one to find it, how exactly he or his engineers were able to access the data within is unknown, given it was likely heavily encrypted.

==$name== and his fleet are rumoured to be preparing for a raid, performing routine maintenance with the long degraded Industrial Pods at ==$location== in the ==$system== system.
jdp_phoenix_bounty.job_comm_reply: Are you here for me? Laughable, surely you know I've gone down with my ship countless times before? The Phoenix will always rise from the ashes.
jdp_phoenix_bounty.job_intel_success: The Domain Era-Datachip was installed into a horribly degraded fabricator on the station, retrieving it was trivial. Unfortunately it appears the way Klaes got access to the data within involved overwriting pretty much all of it, only the Falcon (VI-P) template could be successfully read by an auto-forge, the rest of the Sixth Battlegroup's Secrets are still lost.

jdp_chuuni_bounty.job_description:
While the Alpha Site itself was both the end of the trail of the elusive ISS Hamstu and the birthplace of the TTS Xenomorphica, notes recovered by your salvor team indicate another purpose to the facility. A prototype vessel intended to be operated by a human-AI hybrid crew was clearly in development, but any potentially produced hulls were seemingly long gone by the time of your arrival. Investigating the system's decaying navigation satellite turned out to be the key, having logged the departure of the ==$shipName== under the command of Captain ==$name==, likely just before that functionality died to radiation damage. 

While the specifics of the hull are impossible to determine from this dearth of information, the flightplan of the vessel can be trivially determined, ==$name== likely assumed the Alpha Site would never be found and so made no attempt to hide her tracks. The vessel is most likely hiding in the ==$system== system. Why exactly they didn’t return to a ==Tri-Tachyon== friendly system is unknown, but the legality of such a vessel is self-evidently in dispute and could have caused a diplomatic incident if intercepted by the Hegemony.
jdp_chuuni_bounty.job_comm_reply:
So our paths have finally crossed at last. I knew the Overseers would send someone to retrieve the ==$shipName==. Unfortunately for you, it is needed to reach the Ethereal Horizon, the Singing told me so. You will have to take it from me by force, our battle shall be legendary!

Reality be rent... Synapse break... Banishment this world!
jdp_chuuni_bounty.job_intel_success: With the recovery of the ==$shipName==, it is obvious this vessel could be immensely deadly in the right hands, it is a valuable enough asset.

jdp_anvil_bounty.job_description:
Your technology officer has flagged what appears to be a HEGINT report for your review, an attached data-tag provides explanation.

[NOTE FROM TECHNOLOGY OFFICER: REPORT FOUND ON HOLONET DURING OPEN-SOURCE INTELLIGENCE GATHERING, LIKELY LEAKED DELIBERATELY BY HEGINT PERSONNEL TO DRAW ATTENTION TO PERSEAN LEAGUE TASKFORCE SOUTH-EAST]

(REPORT BEGINS)

Long-range readings provided by HEGINT asset indicate substantial ==Persean League== presence in ==$system== system, likely staging ground dertemined to be ==$location==. So-called Taskforce South-East likely lead by Prime Navarch ==$name== given recent disappearance from post at Kazeron. ==$name== considered CLASS-2 Threat, one of few Navarchs promoted on merit [ref rep HEGINT/LEAGUE-C15-41]. Given lack of fleet building capabilities at Salamanca, likely fleet was given passage from Kazeron through TT Space. 

HEGINT assets report presence of Eider-class, ==$shipName== and Shoebill-class ==PLS [NAME UNKNOWN]==. Enemy warfighting capability in fleet action is unknown, few action reports involving these vessels [ref rep HEGINT/LEAGUE-C12-84]. Conclude: with near certainty, imminent Persean League harrying operation at Naraka. Recommend, no official sabotage operation, limit Persean League tactical data against Hegemony forces. Budget [sum value ==$reward==] made available for mercenary recruitment.

(REPORT ENDS)
jdp_anvil_bounty.job_comm_reply: I assume you saw that leaked report... Such cowardly tactics, siccing the populous of the sector against us, but that's to be expected from those low dogs on Chicomoztoc.
jdp_anvil_bounty.job_intel_success: Following the destruction of Taskforce South-East, ==400000 credits== appeared in one of your accounts from an unknown source, likely the black budget of HEGINT. The fact that they know the details of your personal accounts is very unnerving.
